raw.details:
Overview:

Welcome to ZENITH’26 – The AI Voyage, a national-level technical event organized by SCOPE Club, MLRIT, Hyderabad, featuring AWS Student Community Day followed by a 2-Day Hackathon.

Event Dates:

  • 17 December 2026: AWS Student Community Day.

  • 18 December 2026: Hackathon Kickoff.

  • 19 December 2026: Hackathon Finale.

Eligibility Criteria:

  • Team Size: 2-4 members.

  • Participation: Open to undergraduate students across India (II to IV yr students).

  • Team Formation: Inter-college teams are allowed.

Hackathon Domains:

There are three domains, each having multiple use cases. Teams must select any one use case from their preferred domain.

  • Healthcare

  • Retail

  • BFSI (Banking, Financial Services & Insurance)

Event Structure:

Round 1 – Online Ideation Round (Via Unstop)

  • Teams must select one use case from the provided problem statements.

  • Each team must prepare and submit a presentation using the official PPT template provided by the organizers.

  • Teams must strictly follow all the guidelines and rules mentioned in the problem statement description.

  • The presentation must clearly explain the selected problem statement and the proposed solution.

PPT Presentation Guidelines:

The presentation must cover the following four sections:

  • Team & Problem: Include Team ID, team name, track, college, Problem ID (as provided in the nomination email), target user, one real-world situation, and 1–3 root causes labelled P1, P2, and P3.

  • Our Approach: Explain your solution in 2–3 sentences. Describe each part of the solution, the problem cause it addresses, and how it works. Highlight what makes your solution different from common approaches.

  • Design & Tech Stack: List each tool, its role, and why it was selected over alternatives. Include 2–3 key technical decisions, rejected alternatives, and reasons for rejecting them. A diagram is optional.

  • Validation & Honesty: Include one worked example showing input, steps, and output. Explain how success will be measured using metrics, targets, and measurement methods. Mention the biggest risk and mitigation plan, data used and its source, AI tools used, and code repository link (or N/A).

Submission Rules & Guidelines:

  • Teams must strictly follow the official PPT template and cover all four mandatory sections.

  • Only presentations prepared using the given template will be considered for evaluation.

  • Teams must ensure that their presentations reflect their own understanding, ideas, and technical approach.

  • Presentations will undergo AI-based evaluation.

  • Excessive use of AI-generated content may reduce the chances of shortlisting.

Evaluation Criteria:

Submissions will be evaluated based on:

  • Innovation and originality of the proposed solution.

  • Feasibility of the proposed solution.

  • Technical approach and implementation strategy.

  • Real-world impact and practical applicability.

  • Clarity and authenticity of the presentation.

PPT File Naming Convention

All submissions must be saved in PPT format using the following naming convention:

TEAM_ID_Domain_UseCaseNumber.pptx

  • Example: TEAM001_Healthcare_01.pptx

  • The Team ID and other important details will be shared with the respective team leader via their registered email after successful team registration.

  • Teams must use the Team ID and relevant details provided in the email while naming their PPT submissions.

Shortlisting:

  • Submissions will be evaluated on a rolling basis across all three domains.

  • Teams meeting the evaluation criteria may be shortlisted anytime after submitting their entries, even before the deadline.

  • Shortlisted teams will qualify for Round 2, the on-site hackathon.

Round 1 Submission Deadline: 04 December 2026.

Round 1 – Completely Free

  • No registration or participation fee is required for the online ideation round.

Round 2 – On-Site Hackathon Finale (MLRIT, Hyderabad)

  • Shortlisted teams from Round 1 will qualify for the on-site 2-day hackathon.

  • Participants will work on their selected problem statements to develop functional prototypes.

  • Detailed versions of the selected problem statements will be shared before the hackathon begins.

  • Teams will refine their solutions, implement their ideas, and prepare their final presentations.

  • Projects will be evaluated by an expert jury panel based on creativity, technical execution, collaboration, innovation, and real-world applicability.

Dates: 18–19 December 2026.

Round 2 – Participation guidelines:

  • Additional information will be communicated to the shortlisted teams through the same registered email sent to the team leader containing the Team ID and other important details.

  • Teams must follow the instructions provided in the email to confirm their participation in the on-site hackathon.

  • Food and refreshments will be provided throughout the event.

  • Accommodation will be provided free of cost to students travelling from outside Hyderabad.

How to Register (Via Unstop):

Step 1: Getting Started

  • Click on the "Register" button located on this page.

Step 2: Sign In

  • Choose your sign-in option:

    • Google

    • LinkedIn

    • Email

Enter your details:

  • Phone Number
  • Email

  • Wait for the OTP on your phone and enter it.

Step 3: Your Basic Info

Fill in the following details:

  • Your name
  • School or workplace
  • Course details
  • Graduation date
  • Country of residence

Step 4: Team Time

If you're the Team Leader:

  • Create your team.

  • Choose a team name.

  • Add teammate's emails.

  • Remind them to check their email for the "View Opportunity" link.

  • Watch for teammate's names to turn GREEN once they join!

If you're joining someone's team:

  • Find the team's name.

  • Click "Send Request".

  • Wait for the team leader to add you.

Step 5: PPT Submission

  • Download the PPT template.

  • Create your PPT with the team.

  • Submit your PPT in the PPT Submission box.

  • Save your PPT using the official file naming convention: TEAM_ID_Domain_UseCaseNumber.pptx.

  • Your Team ID and other important details will be shared with the team leader via their registered email after successful team registration.

Step 6: Final Check

  • Find the "View Details" button.

    • If it's GREEN = You're all set!

    • If it's RED = Someone still needs to confirm.

  • Make sure everyone confirms their participation – green names mean your team is ready!

Platform of Event:

Offline – On-Campus

Venue:

MLR Institute of Technology (MLRIT), Hyderabad, Telangana.

Get ready to learn, innovate, collaborate, and build solutions that make a difference.

Be part of ZENITH’26 – The AI Voyage, Where Innovation Meets Impact!
